title: Directed acyclic circuit
statement: A circuit with $n$ input vertices consists of a finite ordered list of gates and an output vertex. Each gate at position $i$ reads only vertices with index less than $n+i$, and the output vertex has index less than $n$ plus the number of gates.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ specifying the number of input vertices

The output index is less than $n$ plus the number of gates
